row.notes: Switches the garage monitor container between minimised (mode 0) and fullscreen (mode 1) view. pdata 0x141f76000-0x141f76ab6: returns at once when dword container+0x940 == mode (0x141f7601c), else stores mode there (0x141f76034) and walks the local players ([[0x146044988]+0x20]+0x140 entries +0x198/+0x1a0). Mode 0 (0x141f761a3): resolves #session.time_change.values.normal / current_value nodes (Vm_Resolve_RegistryNode, Ne_Property_SetUIDBRefIfChanged), finds two entity components, asks Game_RacingCameraArbitrator_RequiresCrossfade, dispatches set_render_mode_minimised_view and show_backround_static, vcall +0xb0, copies four 16-byte blocks from 0x146053c88.. and posts bus messages on g_Game_MessageBus. Mode 1 (0x141f76790): per player caches [[c+0x970]+0x38]+0x98+40*idx -> +0x2a0 into c+0x980+8*idx, matches it in [c+0x978]+0x40.., calls 0x141f75a50, posts bus messages, dispatches show_backround_static and set_render_mode_fullscreen_view, vcall +0xb8, copies blocks from 0x146053f68... Callers: 0x141f74cd2 (mode 1, the container command handler's path when +0x958 == 0) and 0x14c6040a3 (mode 0, .data1 body behind the thunk 0x141f75890). A forced re-entry needs +0x940 reset first, as the red-flag-pit addon does (c+0x940 = 0, then SetViewMode(c, 1)). void. Strings: set_render_mode_minimised_view 0x145760d0c, set_render_mode_fullscreen_view 0x145760d41, show_backround_static 0x145760d2b, #session.time_change.values.normal 0x145760cc6.
